verdict.rationale: LibreOffice is a locally installed desktop office suite that works directly on the user's own files. It has no hosted production environment or production dataset that a separate sandbox could isolate from, so this story is a category error for this kind of product. Features like --safe-mode (temporary fresh profile for troubleshooting), -env custom profile paths and --view read-only mode are adjacent controls, not a sandbox testing environment, so they do not make the axis apply.
